title: Very nice
text: Very nice. Well made, fits my mattress nicely.  Only thing I found disappointing is that it is supposed to keep one cooler and not hold in all the body heat.  Either my husband and I are hot potatoes and we're too much for the protector....or it just doesn't work as well as I had thought it might....but that's okay.  It still is a nice product.
